clinical_note: Maria Alvarez (MRN 00482913, DOB 1979-04-12) presents with low back pain radiating to the left leg for 9 weeks. Completed 6 weeks of physical therapy and a trial of naproxen without improvement. Neuro exam: diminished left ankle reflex, strength 5/5. No fever, no bladder or bowel changes, no history of cancer. Patient is being considered for epidural steroid injection.

James Okafor reports low back pain for 3 weeks after lifting boxes. Taking ibuprofen. No physical therapy yet. Neuro exam normal. No fever, no bladder or bowel changes, no history of cancer. Requests MRI for reassurance.

Robert Chen has type 2 diabetes (E11.9). HbA1c 8.4% measured 30 days ago. On metformin 2000 mg daily for 7 months with inadequate control. No personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma or MEN2. No history of pancreatitis.
Linda Park has type 2 diabetes (E11.65). HbA1c 9.1% measured 20 days ago. Metformin 1500 mg daily for 5 months. Family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma in her mother.
Thomas Reed snores loudly with witnessed apneas. STOP-BANG score 6. Epworth 14. On chronic opioid therapy (oxycodone) for back pain. No neuromuscular disease.

Susan Miller has right knee pain with occasional catching for 4 months. MRI shows degenerative medial meniscal tear. Weight-bearing radiographs show Kellgren-Lawrence grade 4 osteoarthritis. Completed 8 weeks of physical therapy.
